+"""
+Background debounced cloud sync worker for Canvases:
+1. Git: commits and pushes chat_context/canvases/ to origin main.
+2. Google Drive: copies chat_context/canvases/ to VFT:Gemini Canvases via rclone.
+"""
+import re
+import subprocess
+import threading
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .db import CANVASES_DIR, ROOT
+
+REPO_ROOT = ROOT.parent  # e:\Vector Field Theory\VFT Docs
+SYNC_DELAY = 30  # seconds to wait after last canvas edit before pushing
+GDRIVE_ROOT_FOLDER_ID = "1eFfacNbz1A45n_yVH6m2l4jN7LvTBF7S"  # VFT root folder on GDrive
+GDOCS_STAGING_DIR = ROOT / "drawing_board" / "gdocs_staging"
+
+
+def prepare_gdocs_staging():
+    """Converts updated .md canvases into clean .docx files for Google Docs import."""
+    GDOCS_STAGING_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for md_file in CANVASES_DIR.rglob("*.md"):
+        rel = md_file.relative_to(CANVASES_DIR)
+        docx_file = GDOCS_STAGING_DIR / rel.parent / (rel.stem + ".docx")
+        if docx_file.exists() and docx_file.stat().st_mtime >= md_file.stat().st_mtime:
+            continue
+        docx_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        raw_text = md_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+        clean_text = re.sub(r"^---\n.*?\n---\n+", "", raw_text, flags=re.S)
+        try:
+            p = subprocess.Popen(
+                ["pandoc", "-f", "markdown", "-t", "docx", "-o", str(docx_file)],
+                stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
+                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+                text=True,
+                encoding="utf-8",
+            )
+            p.communicate(input=clean_text, timeout=20)
+        except Exception as err:
+            print(f"[canvas-sync] Pandoc conversion error for {md_file.name}: {err}", flush=True)
+
+
+class CanvasCloudSync:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._timer = None
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+        self._changed_titles = set()
+        self._is_syncing = False
+        self.last_sync_time = None
+        self.last_sync_status = "idle"
+
+    def notify_change(self, canvas_title: str):
+        """Called whenever a canvas file is written or updated on disk."""
+        with self._lock:
+            self._changed_titles.add(canvas_title)
+            if self._timer:
+                self._timer.cancel()
+            self._timer = threading.Timer(SYNC_DELAY, self._on_timer)
+            self._timer.daemon = True
+            self._timer.start()
+            print(f"[canvas-sync] Scheduled auto-sync in {SYNC_DELAY}s for '{canvas_title}'", flush=True)
+
+    def trigger_immediate(self):
+        """Triggers an immediate sync, cancelling any pending debounced timer."""
+        with self._lock:
+            if self._timer:
+                self._timer.cancel()
+                self._timer = None
+            titles = list(self._changed_titles)
+            self._changed_titles.clear()
+
+        threading.Thread(target=self._run_sync, args=(titles,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _on_timer(self):
+        with self._lock:
+            titles = list(self._changed_titles)
+            self._changed_titles.clear()
+            self._timer = None
+
+        threading.Thread(target=self._run_sync, args=(titles,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _run_sync(self, titles):
+        if self._is_syncing:
+            print("[canvas-sync] Sync already in progress, skipping overlapping run", flush=True)
+            return
+
+        self._is_syncing = True
+        self.last_sync_status = "syncing"
+        print(f"[canvas-sync] Starting sync for: {titles or 'all canvases'}", flush=True)
+
+        # --- 1. Git Auto-Commit and Push (Dedicated Repo: alisru/gemini-canvases) ---
+        git_ok = False
+        try:
+            status_res = subprocess.run(
+                ["git", "status", "--porcelain"],
+                cwd=CANVASES_DIR,
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                timeout=15,
+            )
+            has_changes = bool(status_res.stdout.strip())
+            if has_changes:
+                subprocess.run(
+                    ["git", "add", "."],
+                    cwd=CANVASES_DIR,
+                    check=True,
+                    timeout=15,
+                )
+                if titles:
+                    title_summary = titles[0] if len(titles) == 1 else f"{len(titles)} canvases ({', '.join(titles[:2])})"
+                    commit_msg = f"auto(canvas): update {title_summary}"
+                else:
+                    commit_msg = "auto(canvas): sync canvases"
+
+                commit_res = subprocess.run(
+                    ["git", "commit", "-m", commit_msg],
+                    cwd=CANVASES_DIR,
+                    capture_output=True,
+                    text=True,
+                    timeout=20,
+                )
+                if commit_res.returncode == 0:
+                    print(f"[canvas-sync] Git committed (gemini-canvases): {commit_msg}", flush=True)
+                    push_res = subprocess.run(
+                        ["git", "push", "origin", "main"],
+                        cwd=CANVASES_DIR,
+                        capture_output=True,
+                        text=True,
+                        timeout=45,
+                    )
+                    if push_res.returncode == 0:
+                        print("[canvas-sync] Git pushed to gemini-canvases origin main successfully", flush=True)
+                        git_ok = True
+                    else:
+                        print(f"[canvas-sync] Git push failed: {push_res.stderr.strip()}", flush=True)
+                else:
+                    print(f"[canvas-sync] Git commit note: {commit_res.stdout.strip() or commit_res.stderr.strip()}", flush=True)
+            else:
+                print("[canvas-sync] Git: working tree clean for gemini-canvases, nothing to commit", flush=True)
+                git_ok = True
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"[canvas-sync] Git error: {e}", flush=True)
+
+        # --- 2. Google Drive Sync as Native Google Docs ---
+        gdrive_ok = False
+        try:
+            if CANVASES_DIR.exists():
+                prepare_gdocs_staging()
+                rclone_res = subprocess.run(
+                    [
+                        "rclone",
+                        "copy",
+                        str(GDOCS_STAGING_DIR),
+                        "VFT:Canvases",
+                        "--drive-root-folder-id",
+                        GDRIVE_ROOT_FOLDER_ID,
+                        "--drive-import-formats",
+                        "docx",
+                        "--drive-allow-import-name-change",
+                        "--tpslimit",
+                        "3",
+                        "--contimeout",
+                        "15s",
+                        "--timeout",
+                        "90s",
+                    ],
+                    capture_output=True,
+                    text=True,
+                    timeout=300,
+                )
+                if rclone_res.returncode == 0:
+                    print("[canvas-sync] Google Drive: canvases synced successfully as native Google Docs to 'VFT:Canvases'", flush=True)
+                    gdrive_ok = True
+                else:
+                    print(f"[canvas-sync] Google Drive sync error: {rclone_res.stderr.strip()}", flush=True)
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"[canvas-sync] Google Drive error: {e}", flush=True)
+
+        self._is_syncing = False
+        self.last_sync_time = time.time()
+        self.last_sync_status = "ok" if (git_ok and gdrive_ok) else "partial_or_error"
+        self.last_sync_status = "ok" if (git_ok and gdrive_ok) else "partial_or_error"
+
+
+cloud_sync = CanvasCloudSync()

+def related_live(body: dict = Body(...), con=Depends(get_con)):
+    """Find related chats for a given chat_id, url, or free-text query from Gemini."""
+    cid = body.get("chat_id")
+    url = body.get("url")
+    text = (body.get("text") or "").strip()
+    k = int(body.get("k", 8))
+
+    # Resolve chat_id if only url is provided
+    if not cid and url:
+        r = con.execute("SELECT id FROM chats WHERE url=?", (url,)).fetchone()
+        if r:
+            cid = r["id"]
+
+    ids, mat = load_chat_vectors(con)
+
+    # 1. If we have a recognized chat in our vectors, use standard chat vector similarity
+    if cid and cid in ids and len(mat):
+        sims = mat @ mat[ids.index(cid)]
+        mine = _chunks(con, cid)
+        out = []
+        for i in np.argsort(-sims):
+            if ids[i] == cid:
+                continue
+            row = con.execute("SELECT id, title, updated FROM chats WHERE id=?", (ids[i],)).fetchone()
+            if not row:
+                continue
+            out.append({**dict(row), "score": round(float(sims[i]), 3), "why": _why(mine, _chunks(con, ids[i]))})
+            if len(out) >= k:
+                break
+        if out:
+            return out
+
+    # 2. Otherwise, if text or title was passed (or extracted from chat), embed and search
+    if text and len(mat):
+        qv = embed_texts([text[:1000]])[0]
+        sims = mat @ qv
+        out = []
+        for i in np.argsort(-sims):
+            if cid and ids[i] == cid:
+                continue
+            row = con.execute("SELECT id, title, updated FROM chats WHERE id=?", (ids[i],)).fetchone()
+            if not row:
+                continue
+            # Get closest chunk as explanation
+            chunks_other = _chunks(con, ids[i])
+            best_chunk = ""
+            if len(chunks_other[1]):
+                sim_c = chunks_other[1] @ qv
+                best_chunk = chunks_other[0][int(np.argmax(sim_c))][:300]
+            out.append({
+                **dict(row),
+                "score": round(float(sims[i]), 3),
+                "why": {"shared": [], "match": round(float(sims[i]), 3), "this": text[:200], "other": best_chunk}
+            })
+            if len(out) >= k:
+                break
+        if out:
+            return out
+
+    # 3. Fallback to recent chats if no matches or no text
+    recent = con.execute("SELECT id, title, updated FROM chats ORDER BY updated DESC LIMIT ?", (k,)).fetchall()
+    return [{"id": r["id"], "title": r["title"], "updated": r["updated"], "score": 0.0, "why": None} for r in recent if r["id"] != cid]

+  function insertIntoGeminiPrompt(text, title) {
+    const editor = document.querySelector('rich-textarea .ql-editor') ||
+                   document.querySelector('div[contenteditable="true"][role="textbox"]') ||
+                   document.querySelector('.ql-editor') ||
+                   document.querySelector('textarea[aria-label*="prompt" i]') ||
+                   document.querySelector('div[contenteditable="true"]');
+
+    const formatted = `\n\n<context>\n${title ? `[Reference: ${title}]\n` : ''}${text.trim()}\n</context>\n\n`;
+
+    if (!editor) {
+      navigator.clipboard.writeText(formatted);
+      return 'copied';
+    }
+
+    editor.focus();
+
+    let success = false;
+    try {
+      success = document.execCommand('insertText', false, formatted);
+    } catch (e) {
+      success = false;
+    }
+
+    if (!success) {
+      if (editor.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'textarea' || editor.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'input') {
+        const start = editor.selectionStart || editor.value.length;
+        const end = editor.selectionEnd || editor.value.length;
+        editor.value = editor.value.substring(0, start) + formatted + editor.value.substring(end);
+        editor.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
+        editor.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
+      } else {
+        let p = editor.querySelector('p:last-child');
+        if (!p) {
+          p = document.createElement('p');
+          editor.appendChild(p);
+        }
+        if (p.textContent === editor.getAttribute('data-placeholder')) {
+          p.textContent = '';
+        }
+        p.textContent += formatted;
+        editor.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
+        editor.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
+      }
+    }
+
+    editor.scrollTop = editor.scrollHeight;
+    return 'inserted';
+  }

+        btnEl.textContent = successLabel;
+        setTimeout(() => { if (btnEl) btnEl.textContent = orig; }, 1500);
+      }
+    });
+  }

+  function executeBulkPack(action, btnEl) {

+      }
+    });
+  }

+  // --- High-Fidelity LaTeX & Markdown Preservation Engine ---
+  function extractTeX(el) {
+    if (!el) return null;
+
+    let current = el;
+    while (current && current.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
+      const dataMath = current.getAttribute('data-math');
+      if (dataMath && dataMath.trim()) return dataMath.trim();
+
+      const dataTex = current.getAttribute('data-tex') || current.getAttribute('data-latex') || current.getAttribute('data-latex-source');
+      if (dataTex && dataTex.trim()) return dataTex.trim();
+
+      const title = current.getAttribute('title');
+      if (title && title.trim() && (title.includes('\\') || title.includes('_') || title.includes('^'))) {
+        return title.trim();
+      }
+      current = current.parentNode;
+    }
+
+    const src = el.querySelector('.math-src');
+    if (src && src.textContent.trim()) return src.textContent.trim();
+
+    const annotation = el.querySelector('annotation[encoding="application/x-tex"], annotation');
+    if (annotation && annotation.textContent.trim()) return annotation.textContent.trim();
+
+    const math = el.querySelector('math[alttext]');
+    if (math && math.getAttribute('alttext')?.trim()) return math.getAttribute('alttext').trim();
+
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  function replaceKaTeX(root) {
+    if (!root) return;
+
+    // 0. Custom math tags (<math-block>, <math-inline>)
+    root.querySelectorAll('math-block, math-inline').forEach(node => {
+      if (!node.parentNode) return;
+      const tex = extractTeX(node);
+      if (!tex) return;
+      const isBlock = node.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'math-block' || !!node.querySelector('.katex-display');
+      const replacement = document.createTextNode(isBlock ? `\n\n$$\n${tex}\n$$\n\n` : ` $${tex}$ `);
+      node.parentNode.replaceChild(replacement, node);
+    });
+
+    // 1. Bare display math (.katex-display)
+    root.querySelectorAll('.katex-display').forEach(display => {
+      if (!display.parentNode) return;
+      const tex = extractTeX(display);
+      if (tex) {
+        display.parentNode.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(`\n\n$$\n${tex}\n$$\n\n`), display);
+      }
+    });
+
+    // 2. Bare inline math (.katex)
+    root.querySelectorAll('.katex').forEach(inline => {
+      if (!inline.parentNode) return;
+      const tex = extractTeX(inline);
+      if (tex) {
+        inline.parentNode.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(` $${tex}$ `), inline);
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  function renderTableToMarkdown(tableNode) {
+    let md = '';
+    const rows = Array.from(tableNode.querySelectorAll('tr'));
+    if (rows.length === 0) return '';
+
+    rows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
+      const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('th, td'));
+      let rowStr = '|';
+      cells.forEach(cell => {
+        rowStr += ` ${cell.textContent.trim().replace(/\|/g, '\\|')} |`;
+      });
+      md += rowStr + '\n';
+
+      if (rowIndex === 0) {
+        let separator = '|';
+        cells.forEach(() => {
+          separator += ' --- |';
+        });
+        md += separator + '\n';
+      }
+    });
+    return md;
+  }
+
+  function htmlToMarkdown(element) {
+    if (!element) return '';
+    const clone = element.cloneNode(true);
+    replaceKaTeX(clone);
+
+    // Pre-process code block headers
+    const codeHeaders = clone.querySelectorAll('.code-block-header');
+    codeHeaders.forEach(header => {
+      const langSpan = header.querySelector('span');
+      const langText = langSpan ? langSpan.textContent.trim() : '';
+      const pre = header.nextElementSibling;
+      if (pre && pre.tagName === 'PRE') {
+        pre.setAttribute('data-language', langText);
+      }
+      header.remove();
+    });
+
+    function processNode(node) {
+      if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
+        return node.nodeValue || '';
+      }
+      if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
+        return '';
+      }
+
+      let childrenVal = '';
+      node.childNodes.forEach(child => {
+        childrenVal += processNode(child);
+      });
+
+      const tag = node.tagName.toUpperCase();
+      switch (tag) {
+        case 'H1': return `\n\n# ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+        case 'H2': return `\n\n## ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+        case 'H3': return `\n\n### ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+        case 'H4': return `\n\n#### ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+        case 'H5': return `\n\n##### ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+        case 'H6': return `\n\n###### ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+        case 'P':
+          if (node.parentNode && node.parentNode.tagName === 'LI') {
+            return childrenVal.trim();
+          }
+          return `\n\n${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+        case 'STRONG':
+        case 'B':
+          return `**${childrenVal.trim()}**`;
+        case 'EM':
+        case 'I':
+          return `*${childrenVal.trim()}*`;
+        case 'DEL':
+        case 'S':
+        case 'STRIKE':
+          return `~~${childrenVal.trim()}~~`;
+        case 'CODE':
+          if (node.parentNode && node.parentNode.tagName === 'PRE') {
+            return childrenVal;
+          }
+          return `\`${childrenVal.trim()}\``;
+        case 'PRE':
+          const lang = node.getAttribute('data-language') || '';
+          node.querySelectorAll('button, .copy-code-button').forEach(b => b.remove());
+          const codeText = node.textContent.trim();
+          return `\n\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${codeText}\n\`\`\`\n\n`;
+        case 'BLOCKQUOTE':
+          const bqLines = childrenVal.trim().split('\n');
+          return '\n\n' + bqLines.map(l => `> ${l}`).join('\n') + '\n\n';
+        case 'UL':
+        case 'OL':
+          return `\n${childrenVal}\n`;
+        case 'LI':
+          const parentTag = node.parentNode ? node.parentNode.tagName : '';
+          if (parentTag === 'OL') {
+            const siblings = Array.from(node.parentNode.children);
+            const idx = siblings.indexOf(node) + 1;
+            return `${idx}. ${childrenVal.trim()}\n`;
+          }
+          return `- ${childrenVal.trim()}\n`;
+        case 'TABLE':
+          return `\n\n${renderTableToMarkdown(node)}\n\n`;
+        case 'HR':
+          return '\n\n---\n\n';
+        case 'BR':
+          return '\n';
+        case 'A':
+          const href = node.getAttribute('href') || '';
+          return `[${childrenVal.trim()}](${href})`;
+        default:
+          return childrenVal;
+      }
+    }
+
+    let md = processNode(clone);
+    return md.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
+  }
+
+  function getCanvasTitleFromElement(el) {
+    if (!el) return '';
+    let title = '';

+    // --- High-Fidelity LaTeX & Markdown Preservation Engine ---
+    function extractTeX(el) {
+        if (!el) return null;
+        let current = el;
+        while (current && current.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
+            const dataMath = current.getAttribute('data-math');
+            if (dataMath && dataMath.trim()) return dataMath.trim();
+            const dataTex = current.getAttribute('data-tex') || current.getAttribute('data-latex') || current.getAttribute('data-latex-source');
+            if (dataTex && dataTex.trim()) return dataTex.trim();
+            const title = current.getAttribute('title');
+            if (title && title.trim() && (title.includes('\\') || title.includes('_') || title.includes('^'))) return title.trim();
+            current = current.parentNode;
+        }
+        const src = el.querySelector('.math-src');
+        if (src && src.textContent.trim()) return src.textContent.trim();
+        const annotation = el.querySelector('annotation[encoding="application/x-tex"], annotation');
+        if (annotation && annotation.textContent.trim()) return annotation.textContent.trim();
+        const math = el.querySelector('math[alttext]');
+        if (math && math.getAttribute('alttext')?.trim()) return math.getAttribute('alttext').trim();
+        return null;
+    }
+
+    function replaceKaTeX(root) {
+        if (!root) return;
+        root.querySelectorAll('math-block, math-inline').forEach(node => {
+            if (!node.parentNode) return;
+            const tex = extractTeX(node);
+            if (!tex) return;
+            const isBlock = node.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'math-block' || !!node.querySelector('.katex-display');
+            node.parentNode.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(isBlock ? `\n\n$$\n${tex}\n$$\n\n` : ` $${tex}$ `), node);
+        });
+        root.querySelectorAll('.katex-display').forEach(display => {
+            if (!display.parentNode) return;
+            const tex = extractTeX(display);
+            if (tex) display.parentNode.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(`\n\n$$\n${tex}\n$$\n\n`), display);
+        });
+        root.querySelectorAll('.katex').forEach(inline => {
+            if (!inline.parentNode) return;
+            const tex = extractTeX(inline);
+            if (tex) inline.parentNode.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(` $${tex}$ `), inline);
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderTableToMarkdown(tableNode) {
+        let md = '';
+        const rows = Array.from(tableNode.querySelectorAll('tr'));
+        if (rows.length === 0) return '';
+        rows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
+            const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('th, td'));
+            let rowStr = '|';
+            cells.forEach(cell => {
+                rowStr += ` ${cell.textContent.trim().replace(/\|/g, '\\|')} |`;
+            });
+            md += rowStr + '\n';
+            if (rowIndex === 0) {
+                let separator = '|';
+                cells.forEach(() => { separator += ' --- |'; });
+                md += separator + '\n';
+            }
+        });
+        return md;
+    }
+
+    function htmlToMarkdown(element) {
+        if (!element) return '';
+        const clone = element.cloneNode(true);
+        replaceKaTeX(clone);
+
+        const codeHeaders = clone.querySelectorAll('.code-block-header');
+        codeHeaders.forEach(header => {
+            const langSpan = header.querySelector('span');
+            const langText = langSpan ? langSpan.textContent.trim() : '';
+            const pre = header.nextElementSibling;
+            if (pre && pre.tagName === 'PRE') pre.setAttribute('data-language', langText);
+            header.remove();
+        });
+
+        function processNode(node) {
+            if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) return node.nodeValue || '';
+            if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return '';
+
+            let childrenVal = '';
+            node.childNodes.forEach(child => { childrenVal += processNode(child); });
+
+            const tag = node.tagName.toUpperCase();
+            switch (tag) {
+                case 'H1': return `\n\n# ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+                case 'H2': return `\n\n## ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+                case 'H3': return `\n\n### ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+                case 'H4': return `\n\n#### ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+                case 'H5': return `\n\n##### ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+                case 'H6': return `\n\n###### ${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+                case 'P':
+                    if (node.parentNode && node.parentNode.tagName === 'LI') return childrenVal.trim();
+                    return `\n\n${childrenVal.trim()}\n\n`;
+                case 'STRONG':
+                case 'B': return `**${childrenVal.trim()}**`;
+                case 'EM':
+                case 'I': return `*${childrenVal.trim()}*`;
+                case 'DEL':
+                case 'S':
+                case 'STRIKE': return `~~${childrenVal.trim()}~~`;
+                case 'CODE':
+                    if (node.parentNode && node.parentNode.tagName === 'PRE') return childrenVal;
+                    return `\`${childrenVal.trim()}\``;
+                case 'PRE':
+                    const lang = node.getAttribute('data-language') || '';
+                    node.querySelectorAll('button, .copy-code-button').forEach(b => b.remove());
+                    return `\n\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${node.textContent.trim()}\n\`\`\`\n\n`;
+                case 'BLOCKQUOTE':
+                    const lines = childrenVal.trim().split('\n');
+                    return '\n\n' + lines.map(l => `> ${l}`).join('\n') + '\n\n';
+                case 'UL':
+                case 'OL': return `\n${childrenVal}\n`;
+                case 'LI':
+                    const parentTag = node.parentNode ? node.parentNode.tagName : '';
+                    if (parentTag === 'OL') {
+                        const siblings = Array.from(node.parentNode.children);
+                        const idx = siblings.indexOf(node) + 1;
+                        return `${idx}. ${childrenVal.trim()}\n`;
+                    }
+                    return `- ${childrenVal.trim()}\n`;
+                case 'TABLE': return `\n\n${renderTableToMarkdown(node)}\n\n`;
+                case 'HR': return '\n\n---\n\n';
+                case 'BR': return '\n';
+                case 'A': return `[${childrenVal.trim()}](${node.getAttribute('href') || ''})`;
+                default: return childrenVal;
+            }
+        }
+        return processNode(clone).replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
+    }

+    function extractChatMessageMarkdown(element) {
+        if (!element) return '';
+        const clone = element.cloneNode(true);
+        const canvasSelectors = [
+            'immersive-entry-chip', 'immersive-editor', 'inline-preview',
+            '[data-test-id*="immersive"]', '[data-test-id*="canvas"]',
+            '.immersive-container', '.canvas-container'
+        ].join(', ');

+        const canvasElements = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll(canvasSelectors));
+        const topCanvases = canvasElements.filter(el => {
+            let p = el.parentElement;
+            while (p && p !== clone) {
+                if (p.matches(canvasSelectors)) return false;
+                p = p.parentElement;
+            }
+            return true;
+        });
+
+        topCanvases.forEach(el => {
+            const title = getCanvasTitleFromElement(el) || 'Canvas';
+            const marker = document.createTextNode(`\n\n[[CANVAS: ${title}]]\n\n`);
+            el.replaceWith(marker);
+        });
+
+        // Remove any remaining stray canvas fragments
+        clone.querySelectorAll(canvasSelectors).forEach(el => el.remove());
+        return htmlToMarkdown(clone);
+    }

+<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Platform Behavior</h2><a id="user-content-platform-behavior" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Platform Behavior" href="#platform-behavior"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
+<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Gemini</h3><a id="user-content-gemini" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Gemini" href="#gemini"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
+<ul dir="auto">
+<li>Extracts user messages, assistant responses, and Gemini thought blocks when available</li>
+<li>Supports <code>Dialog</code>, <code>Canvas</code>, and <code>Both</code></li>
+<li>Can export generated images</li>
+<li>Can optionally attempt visible watermark removal during image export</li>
+<li>File naming prefers Gemini page metadata and falls back to the first user prompt</li>
+</ul>
+<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">ChatGPT</h3><a id="user-content-chatgpt" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ChatGPT" href="#chatgpt"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
+<ul dir="auto">
+<li>Extracts turns from <code>article [class*="group/turn-messages"]</code></li>
+<li>Detects user messages via <code>.user-message-bubble-color</code></li>
+<li>Supports <code>Dialog</code> export</li>
+<li>Reuses the shared anchor panel and export pipeline</li>
+<li>File naming prefers <code>document.title</code>, which maps better to ChatGPT thread titles than DOM headings</li>
+</ul>
+<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Architecture</h2><a id="user-content-architecture" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Architecture" href="#architecture"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
+<p dir="auto">The codebase is split into two layers:</p>
+<ol dir="auto">
+<li>
+<p dir="auto">Platform layer</p>
+<ul dir="auto">
+<li>URL detection</li>
+<li>platform capability flags</li>
+<li>DOM selectors</li>
+<li>title extraction rules</li>
+<li>scroller and anchor hints</li>
+</ul>
+</li>
+<li>
+<p dir="auto">Shared export layer</p>
+<ul dir="auto">
+<li>markdown conversion</li>
+<li>export formatting</li>
+<li>file download</li>
+<li>popup settings</li>
+<li>floating export UI</li>
+</ul>
+</li>
+</ol>
+<p dir="auto">This keeps Gemini-specific and ChatGPT-specific DOM logic out of the shared export pipeline.</p>
+<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Installation</h2><a id="user-content-installation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Installation" href="#installation"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
+<ol dir="auto">
+<li>Clone this repository.</li>
+<li>Open <code>chrome://extensions/</code>.</li>
+<li>Enable <code>Developer mode</code>.</li>
+<li>Click <code>Load unpacked</code>.</li>
+<li>Select this repository directory.</li>
+</ol>
+<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Usage</h2><a id="user-content-usage" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Usage" href="#usage"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
+<ol dir="auto">
+<li>Open a supported conversation page on <a href="https://gemini.google.com/" rel="nofollow">Gemini</a> or <a href="https://chatgpt.com/" rel="nofollow">ChatGPT</a>.</li>
+<li>Open the extension popup and choose:
+<ul dir="auto">
+<li>language</li>
+<li>export format</li>
+<li>export type</li>
+<li>Gemini watermark-removal option if needed</li>
+</ul>
+</li>
+<li>Click the floating <code>Export</code> button on the page.</li>
+<li>Wait for the download to complete.</li>
+</ol>
+<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Export Types</h2><a id="user-content-export-types" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Export Types" href="#export-types"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
+<ul dir="auto">
+<li><code>Dialog</code>: exports the conversation turns</li>
+<li><code>Canvas</code>: exports Gemini canvas content only</li>
+<li><code>Both</code>: combines Gemini dialog and canvas content when both exist</li>
+</ul>
+<p dir="auto">For ChatGPT, <code>Canvas</code> and <code>Both</code> currently degrade to dialog-only behavior because ChatGPT canvas/artifact support has not been implemented in this extension.</p>

+Remove the additional `:invalid` styles in Firefox. (https://github.com/mozilla/gecko-dev/blob/2f9eacd9d3d995c937b4251a5557d95d494c9be1/layout/style/res/forms.css#L728-L737)

+/*
+Add the correct vertical alignment in Chrome and Firefox.
+*/

+/*
+Correct the cursor style of increment and decrement buttons in Safari.
+*/
+

+/*
+1. Correct the odd appearance in Chrome and Safari.
+2. Correct the outline style in Safari.
+*/
+
+[type='search'] {
+  -webkit-appearance: textfield; /* 1 */
+  outline-offset: -2px; /* 2 */

+/*
+Remove the inner padding in Chrome and Safari on macOS.
+*/
+
+::-webkit-search-decoration {
+  -webkit-appearance: none;

+/*
+1. Correct the inability to style clickable types in iOS and Safari.
+2. Change font properties to `inherit` in Safari.

+

+  font: inherit; /* 2 */

+/*
+1. Use the user's configured `mono` font-family by default.
+2. Use the user's configured `mono` font-feature-settings by default.
+3. Use the user's configured `mono` font-variation-settings by default.
+4. Correct the odd `em` font sizing in all browsers.
+*/

+samp,

+  font-variation-settings: normal; /* 3 */

+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+html_path = Path("html base/Failed Markdown Canvas Generation - Google Gemini.html")
+if not html_path.exists():
+    print("File not found:", html_path)
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+content = html_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+print(f"Loaded HTML, length: {len(content)} characters")
+
+# Find conversation / message containers
+message_tags = set(re.findall(r'<([a-zA-Z0-9\-_]+)[^>]*?message[^>]*?>', content, re.IGNORECASE))
+print("Message-related tags:", message_tags)
+
+# Find all custom elements (tags with a hyphen)
+custom_tags = set(re.findall(r'<([a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9\-]+)', content, re.IGNORECASE))
+print("\nCustom HTML elements with hyphens:")
+for t in sorted(custom_tags):
+    if any(k in t.lower() for k in ['canvas', 'artifact', 'panel', 'editor', 'card', 'item', 'response', 'content', 'immersive', 'code']):
+        print(f"  <{t}>")
+
+sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
+
+# Search for immersive-entry-chip and immersive-editor
+print("\n--- IMMERSIVE-ENTRY-CHIP STRUCTURE ---")
+chip_match = re.search(r'<immersive-entry-chip[\s\S]*?</immersive-entry-chip>', content, re.IGNORECASE)
+if chip_match:
+    chip = chip_match.group(0)
+    print("Full length:", len(chip))
+    # Replace long text content but keep tag hierarchy
+    tags = re.findall(r'<([a-zA-Z0-9\-_]+)[^>]*?>', chip)
+    print("Tag hierarchy:", tags[:50])
+    
+    # Check for preview content or text containers
+    preview_match = re.search(r'<div[^>]*?class="[^"]*?content[^"]*?"[\s\S]*?</div>', chip)
+    if preview_match:
+        print("Content div preview:", preview_match.group(0)[:800])
+    else:
+        print("No content div matched, printing raw text of chip:")
+        clean_text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', chip)
+        clean_text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', clean_text).strip()
+        print("Chip clean text:", clean_text[:1000])
+
+print("\n--- SIMULATED JS EXTRACTOR ---")
+# Selectors:
+# 'immersive-entry-chip, immersive-editor, immersive-panel, [data-test-id*="immersive"], [data-test-id*="canvas"], .immersive-container, .canvas-container, [aria-label*="Canvas" i], aside[class*="immersive"]'
+
+containers = []
+# Find immersive-entry-chip
+for m in re.finditer(r'<immersive-entry-chip[\s\S]*?</immersive-entry-chip>', content, re.IGNORECASE):
+    containers.append(('immersive-entry-chip', m.group(0)))
+
+# Find immersive-editor not inside chip
+for m in re.finditer(r'<immersive-editor[\s\S]*?</immersive-editor>', content, re.IGNORECASE):
+    # check if already inside a chip
+    if not any(m.group(0) in c[1] for c in containers):
+        containers.append(('immersive-editor', m.group(0)))
+
+print(f"Total canvas containers identified: {len(containers)}")
+
+for tag, panel in containers:
+    # 1. Title extraction
+    title = ''
+    t_match = re.search(r'class="[^"]*?title[^"]*?"[^>]*?>([^<]+)</div>', panel)
+    if t_match:
+        title = t_match.group(1).strip()
+    if not title:
+        h_match = re.search(r'<h[1-3][^>]*?>([^<]+)</h[1-3]>', panel)
+        if h_match:
+            title = h_match.group(1).strip()
+    if not title:
+        title = "Untitled Canvas"
+        
+    print(f"Extracted Canvas Title: '{title}'")
+    
+    # 2. Content extraction
+    # Check for ProseMirror
+    pm = re.search(r'class="[^"]*?ProseMirror[^"]*?"[^>]*?>([\s\S]*?)</div>\s*</div>', panel)
+    if pm:
+        raw_html = pm.group(1)
+        print(f"  Found ProseMirror content! (Length: {len(raw_html)})")
+        # Check headings and lists in raw_html
+        headings = re.findall(r'<h[1-6][^>]*?>([^<]+)</h[1-6]>', raw_html)
+        print(f"  Headings: {headings}")
+

+# Plan 005: Gemini Canvas Capture & File Storage Architecture
+**Date**: 2026-10-05  
+**Author**: Antigravity  
+**Status**: Completed  
+
+## 1. Goal
+1. Automatically capture Gemini Canvas / Artifact contents whenever a user creates or iterates on a canvas in Gemini Web.
+2. Store each canvas as a dedicated Markdown (`.md`) file inside a chat-specific folder:
+   `chat_context/canvases/<safe_chat_title_or_id>/<canvas_title>.md`
+3. Automatically update these `.md` files whenever new revisions of the canvas are synced.
+4. Index and track canvases in SQLite (`canvases` table) with timestamps and file paths.
+5. Render canvases in the dashboard UI (`ui/index.html`) with previews and quick access.
+6. Concurrently audit and fix memory leaks across the background sync worker, SQLite connection handling, FastEmbed ONNX runtime, and browser extension DOM observer.
+
+## 2. Technical Architecture
+### A. Chrome Extension (`extension/chrome_extension/content.js`)
+- Add `extractCanvases()` targeting:
+  - Open canvas pane / side-by-side surface:
+    - Containers: `[data-test-id*="canvas" i]`, `immersive-panel`, `[aria-label*="Canvas" i]`, `.canvas-surface`, `.code-artifact`, `.document-artifact`
+    - Titles: `[data-test-id="canvas-title"]`, `.canvas-title`, `.immersive-title`, `input.title-input`
+    - Content: CodeMirror (`.cm-content`), Monaco (`.monaco-editor`), ProseMirror / TipTap (`.ProseMirror`, `[contenteditable="true"]`), markdown pre/code blocks.
+  - In-line canvas chips / cards in conversation history.
+- Include `canvases: [{ id, title, content, type, updated }]` in the payload sent to `/api/ingest/payload`.
+
+### B. Database Schema (`ctx/db.py`)
+- Add `canvases` table:
+  ```sql
+  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS canvases (
+      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+      chat_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+      title TEXT NOT NULL,
+      content TEXT NOT NULL,
+      type TEXT,
+      file_path TEXT,
+      updated TEXT NOT NULL,
+      FOREIGN KEY(chat_id) REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
+  );
+  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_canvases_chat ON canvases(chat_id);
+  ```
+
+### C. Ingestion & File Storage (`ctx/ingest.py`)
+- Define `CANVASES_DIR = ROOT / "canvases"`.
+- When `payload` has `canvases`:
+  - Sanitize chat title and canvas title for filenames: `<CANVASES_DIR>/<chat_folder>/<canvas_name>.md`.
+  - Write or update markdown with YAML metadata header.
+  - Upsert into `canvases` table.
+
+### D. Dashboard UI (`ui/index.html`)
+- Display canvas count badge and expandable drawer/panel in the reader pane.
+- Clickable link or copy action for canvas contents.
+
+## 3. Dynamic Sync & Real-Time Revision Architecture
+User reported that chats were no longer dynamically adding/updating automatically. Two root causes were identified and fixed:
+1. **Extension Auto-Triggers (`content.js`)**:
+   - Added SPA URL watcher polling `location.href` every 1s: detects switching conversations in Gemini's sidebar and resets hash to sync the newly selected chat immediately.
+   - Added `characterData: true` to `MutationObserver`: catches streaming text and inline Canvas edits.
+   - Added automatic sync 2s after initial page load without requiring manual button clicks.
+   - Wrapped extractors in `try...catch` guards to prevent DOM query errors from blocking chat sync.
+2. **Real-time Revision Tracking (`server.py` & `ui/index.html`)**:
+   - Added monotonically increasing `STATUS["rev"]` counter.
+   - Increments whenever a chat is ingested (`/api/ingest/chat`), canvases are updated, or background embedding completes.
+   - Dashboard UI polls `s.rev !== lastRev`: instantly reloads the sidebar list and updates the active chat in the reader pane in real-time.

+# Plan 008: High-Fidelity LaTeX & Markdown Preservation Engine
+**Date**: 2026-10-05  
+**Author**: Antigravity  
+**Status**: Completed & Deployed  
+
+## 1. Problem Diagnosed
+Canvases extracted from Gemini Web were previously using `innerText` on the ProseMirror container:
+1. Stripped all Markdown semantic tags: `#` headings, `**` bold, `*` italics, `-` lists, code fences, and tables.
+2. Stripped and mangled LaTeX: KaTeX math spans (`.katex`, `.katex-display`, `<math-block>`, `<math-inline>`) were converted to flattened rendered Unicode glyphs, splitting exponents and subscripts across line breaks and losing original LaTeX syntax (`\upsilon`, `\text{...}`, etc.).
+
+## 2. Solution Implemented
+Integrated the battle-tested LaTeX extraction and Markdown serializer into both the Chrome Extension (`content.js`) and the Tampermonkey Userscript (`gemini_sync_userscript.js`):
+1. **KaTeX Source Recovery (`extractTeX`, `replaceKaTeX`)**:
+   - Inspects `data-math`, `data-tex`, `data-latex`, `data-latex-source`.
+   - Reads `<annotation encoding="application/x-tex">` and `<math alttext="...">`.
+   - Replaces display math (`math-block`, `.katex-display`) with clean `\n\n$$\n${tex}\n$$\n\n`.
+   - Replaces inline math (`math-inline`, `.katex`) with clean ` $${tex}$ `.
+2. **Structural Markdown Serializer (`htmlToMarkdown`)**:
+   - Converts `H1`–`H6` to `#`–`######`.
+   - Converts `P` to paragraph blocks (compact inside `LI`).
+   - Converts `STRONG`/`B` to `**...**` and `EM`/`I` to `*...*`.
+   - Converts `CODE` and `PRE` (with language attribute preservation).
+   - Formats `UL`, `OL`, `LI` lists with proper indentation.
+   - Converts HTML `TABLE` into clean Markdown tables (`| ... |`).
+   - Retains blockquotes (`> ...`), horizontal rules (`---`), and links.
+3. **Applied to Both Canvases and Assistant Chat Responses**:
+   - Both `.ProseMirror` canvas editors and assistant message bubbles now export with 100% preserved LaTeX and Markdown hierarchy.
+4. **Frontmatter Kept**:
+   - Retains the structured YAML metadata at the top of canvas `.md` files as requested.

+# Plan 009: Inline Canvas Extraction & Gemini DOM Alignment
+**Date**: 2026-10-05  
+**Author**: Antigravity

+
+## 1. Ground Truth Discovery from Saved HTML
+Analysis of `chat_context/html base/Failed Markdown Canvas Generation - Google Gemini.html` revealed the exact DOM structure for Gemini's current inline canvas rendering:
+1. **No `<immersive-panel>`**: In Gemini's current inline interface, `immersive-panel` only exists in CSS style definitions; it is NOT rendered in the live DOM for inline canvases.
+2. **`<immersive-entry-chip>` Component**:
+   - Inline canvases are rendered directly inside chat model responses wrapped in `<immersive-entry-chip>`.
+   - Title is rendered in `<div class="title-container"><div class="title-wrapper"><div class="title gds-body-l">Title</div>`.
+   - Content is rendered in `<immersive-editor>` -> `#extended-response-markdown-content .ProseMirror`.
+
+## 2. Changes Made
+1. **Expanded Container Selectors**:
+   - Added `immersive-entry-chip`, `immersive-editor`, and `inline-preview` to the canvas selector query.
+2. **Container Deduplication**:
+   - Added nested parent containment check: skips inner containers if an outer matching container (`immersive-entry-chip` or `immersive-panel`) is already processing the canvas.
+   - Added content/title deduplication.
+3. **Enhanced Title Fallback**:
+   - Queries `.title`, `.title-wrapper .title`, `.title-container .title`, input fields, and falls back to the document's top `<h1>`/`<h2>` if no title element is present in the chip header.
+4. **Maintained Full LaTeX & Markdown Recovery**:
+   - Uses `htmlToMarkdown` to preserve all `#` headings, lists, tables, blockquotes, inline `$ ... $`, and display `$$ ... $$` math blocks.
+5. **Version Bumps**:
+   - Updated both `content.js` and `gemini_sync_userscript.js`.
+   - Bumped `manifest.json` to `1.0.2`.

+# Implementation Plan 012 - Inline Canvas Chat Linking & Interactive In-Flow Cards
+
+**Date**: 2026-10-05  
+**Component**: `chat_context` (Extension, Userscript, Server & Web UI)  
+**Status**: Completed & Verified  
+
+---
+
+## 1. Problem Statement
+When Gemini generates an inline canvas (via `<immersive-entry-chip>` or inline editor), it appears at a specific chronological point within the conversation turn (between introductory setup text and concluding explanatory text).
+Previously:
+1. The canvas text was stripped or dumped raw into the chat bubble text.
+2. When isolated into standalone canvas files, the chat bubble had the canvas text completely removed with no inline reference, leaving a disconnect where the user couldn't see where the canvas was generated.
+3. The user requested: *"pls link in the canvases where they appear in chat"*.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Architecture & Design
+
+### A. Inline DOM Extraction & Marker Placement
+In `chat_context/extension/chrome_extension/content.js` and `chat_context/extension/gemini_sync_userscript.js`:
+- In `extractChatMessageMarkdown(element)`:
+  - Finds all top-level canvas containers (`immersive-entry-chip`, `immersive-editor`, `inline-preview`, `[data-test-id*="immersive"]`, `[data-test-id*="canvas"]`, `.immersive-container`, `.canvas-container`).
+  - Extracts the exact canvas title using `getCanvasTitleFromElement(el)`.
+  - Replaces each top-level canvas element in the DOM clone with:

+  - Inserts the rich interactive canvas card right between surrounding chat paragraphs.

+In `openChat(id)` in `chat_context/ui/index.html`:

+  - If a canvas was not referenced inline (e.g. legacy chats imported prior to marker insertion), its full card is rendered in the top drawer as a fallback so no canvas is ever lost.

+# Implementation Plan 013 - Canvas ID Scoping & Toolbar "Export" Suffix Remediation
+
+**Date**: 2026-10-05  
+**Component**: `chat_context` (Extension, Userscript, Backend Ingestion, Database Schema & UI)  
+**Status**: Completed & Verified  
+
+---
+
+## 1. Problem Diagnosis
+In the server logs, the sync worker logged:
+`[canvas-sync] Starting sync for: ['Domestic Oversaturation and Forced Labor Redeployment AnalysisExport', 'Workforce Deficits and Domestic Career Realignment Under Proposed Migration CutsExport']`
+However, the Workforce Deficits canvas was not appearing in the chat or HTML viewer for *Debunking Authoritarian Property Investor Rants*.
+
+### Root Causes
+1. **Canvas ID Collision Across Chats**:
+   - The browser extension emitted sequential generic IDs (`canvas-1`, `canvas-2`).
+   - In `ctx/ingest.py`, `c_id = cv.get("id")`, so every chat ingested its first canvas under the key `canvas-1`.
+   - The SQLite upsert statement used `ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET title=..., content=...` without updating `chat_id`.
+   - Consequently, `canvas-1` permanently retained the `chat_id` of the first chat that ever registered a canvas (`gemini-965a07d336ea4dda`). When *Debunking Authoritarian Property Investor Rants* (`gemini-dd82cf235ec796b0`) queried `/api/chat/`, its canvas was hidden under a different conversation.
+2. **Toolbar Suffix Leaking into Canvas Titles**:
+   - In Gemini's canvas toolbar, the title container element contains both the title text and adjacent buttons (such as `Export` or `Close`).
+   - Extracting `.textContent` from `.title-wrapper` or `.title-container` resulted in strings like `Workforce Deficits ... CutsExport`.
+   - This corrupted filenames, frontmatter, and inline marker tags.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Implemented Fixes
+
+### A. Ingestion Scoping (`ctx/ingest.py`)
+- Canvas IDs are now explicitly scoped to their chat:
+  `c_id = f"{chat_id}-{raw_cv_id}"`
+- The upsert query now explicitly updates `chat_id`:
+  ```sql
+  INSERT INTO canvases(id, chat_id, title, content, type, file_path, updated)
+  VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
+  ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
+      chat_id=excluded.chat_id,
+      title=excluded.title,
+      content=excluded.content,
+      type=excluded.type,
+      file_path=excluded.file_path,
+      updated=excluded.updated
+  ```
+- Strips any trailing `Export`, `Download`, or `Close` suffixes from `c_title` before saving.
+
+### B. Extension & Userscript Extraction (`content.js` & `gemini_sync_userscript.js`)
+- `getCanvasTitleFromElement(el)` now:
+  - Clones the title element and strips `button`, `[role="button"]`, and icon tags before retrieving `.textContent`.
+  - Strips trailing `Export`, `Download`, or `Close` suffixes via regex: `replace(/\s*(Export|Download|Close)\s*$/i, '')`.
+- Bumped Chrome extension version to `1.1.2`.
+
+### C. Resilient UI Matching (`ui/index.html`)
+- `renderMessageContent` normalizes both the inline marker title and each canvas candidate's title by stripping trailing action words before comparing, guaranteeing matches even if legacy data has minor suffix variances.
+
+### D. Data & Database Migration (`repair_canvases.py`)
+- Executed database repair across all markdown assets in `chat_context/canvases/`.
+- Replaced un-scoped `canvas-N` records with clean, chat-prefixed IDs.
+- Cleaned frontmatter in affected markdown files on disk.
+- Cleaned message tags in `messages` table from `[[CANVAS: ...Export]]` to `[[CANVAS: ...]]`.
+
+---
+
+## 3. Verification & Results
+- Verified `/api/chat/gemini-dd82cf235ec796b0`:
+  - Returns all 4 associated canvases:
+    1. `Workforce Deficits and Domestic Career Realignment Under Proposed Migration Cuts`
+    2. `Domestic Oversaturation and Forced Labor Redeployment Analysis`
+    3. `1. Context: Proposed Migration Contractions`
+    4. `1. Executive Summary: The Arithmetic of Border Autarky`
+  - Messages 6 and 8 contain clean canvas tags.
+  - Both canvases render with interactive preview and copy buttons in the HTML viewer.

+# Implementation Plan 015 - Canvas Accumulation Without Deletion
+
+**Date**: 2026-10-05  
+**Component**: `chat_context` (Ingestion Engine & Persistence)  
+**Status**: Completed & Verified  
+
+---
+
+## 1. Problem Statement
+The user pointed out a critical flaw:
+*"updating can remove canvases, updating removes whats there and replaces it with whats loaded on the gemini page"*.
+
+In Single Page Applications like Gemini:
+- Older or non-active canvases in a long conversation may not be mounted in the DOM at the exact moment a sync occurs (Gemini often only renders the currently active canvas or chips currently in view).
+- In a previous commit, `ctx/ingest.py` executed `DELETE FROM canvases WHERE chat_id = ?` prior to saving incoming canvases from the payload.
+- As a consequence, whenever a chat synced while only one canvas was mounted in the DOM, all other previously captured canvases for that conversation were deleted from the database.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Solution: Additive Accumulation & Merge Storage
+1. **Removed Destructive Deletion**:
+   - Stripped `DELETE FROM canvases WHERE chat_id = ?` from [`ctx/ingest.py`](file:///e:/Vector%20Field%20Theory/VFT%20Docs/chat_context/ctx/ingest.py).
+   - Canvases are treated as persistent, cumulative artifacts of the conversation.
+2. **Deterministic Title-Hash Primary Keys**:
+   - `c_id = f"{chat_id}-{hashlib.sha1(norm_title.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}"`
+   - When Gemini re-sends a canvas that is already saved, SQLite executes `ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET title=..., content=..., updated=...`, updating it in place without creating duplicates.
+   - When Gemini sends a newly generated canvas or one that wasn't in earlier payloads, it is added to the chat's existing collection.
+   - Older canvases that aren't in the current DOM payload remain completely intact in both the database and on disk.
+3. **Server Reload & Verification**:
+   - Restarted `ctx.server` with the non-destructive ingest engine.
+   - Ran [`repair_canvases.py`](file:///e:/Vector%20Field%20Theory/VFT%20Docs/chat_context/repair_canvases.py) to guarantee all on-disk canvases across all chats are restored.

+# Plan 018: Prevent Extraction of ASCII Diagrams / Code Snippets as Canvases
+
+## Date: 2026-10-06
+
+## Problem Description
+- In chats like `Epistemology of Absolute Truth - Google Gemini`, Gemini generated inline ASCII diagram code blocks:
+  - `Ground Truth (T = 1.0) | v ...` (17 lines)
+  - `[ Fundamental Ground Truth (T = 1.0) ] | v ...` (17 lines)
+- These were captured as separate fake "canvases":
+  - `1. The Ontological Metric_ Reality as a Complete S.md` (577 bytes)
+  - `1. Foundational Premise.md` (624 bytes)
+- This obscured the real canvas document (`Epistemic Approximation and the Mechanics of Truth.md`, 12,511 bytes).
+
+## Root Cause
+1. **Over-Permissive DOM Selectors**:
+   `content.js` queried `[aria-label*="Canvas" i]` and `[data-test-id*="canvas"]`.
+   Gemini attaches `aria-label="Open in Canvas"` to buttons near standard chat code blocks and diagrams, causing their parent containers to be matched as canvas candidates.
+2. **Loose Pre/Code Fallback**:
+   When no Monaco or ProseMirror editor was found, the code grabbed any `<pre><code>` snippet.
+3. **Low Length Threshold**:
+   `content.length > 10` accepted any 11+ character code snippet.
+
+## Solution
+1. **Strict Canvas Selectors in `content.js`**:
+   - Limit `canvasContainers` strictly to genuine top-level tags:
+     `'immersive-entry-chip, immersive-editor, immersive-panel, aside[class*="immersive"]'`.
+   - Remove `[aria-label*="Canvas" i]`, `[data-test-id*="canvas"]`, `inline-preview`, and `.canvas-container`.
+2. **Remove Loose Code Block Fallback**:
+   - Genuine code canvases in Gemini use Monaco (`.view-lines`) or CodeMirror (`.cm-content`).
+   - Remove arbitrary `<pre><code>` fallback from non-editor containers.
+3. **Document Length & Structure Guard**:
+   - Enforce minimum canvas length (`content.length >= 250` characters).
+   - In `ingest.py`, skip any canvas candidate where `c_type == 'code'` and `len(c_content) < 250`.
+4. **Clean up Identified Snippet Files**:
+   - Present identified bogus snippet files to user with exact `Remove-Item` command for confirmation before deletion.

+# Implementation Plan 020: Server Memory Leak Fix and ONNX Arena Capping
+
+**Date**: 2026-10-07  
+**Goal**: Eliminate the 5.2 GB server memory ballooning by capping ONNX Runtime thread arena allocations in FastEmbed, throttling background ingest cycles, and optimizing embedding batch size.
+
+## Root Cause Analysis
+1. **Unbounded Thread Arenas in FastEmbed/ONNX Runtime**:
+   - `FastEmbed` initialized `TextEmbedding` with default `threads=None`.
+   - On a 12-core system, ONNX Runtime allocated dedicated memory pools (arenas) across all 12 worker threads.
+   - Combined with default `batch_size=256`, every batch triggered huge multi-gigabyte memory allocations that ONNX never released to the OS.
+2. **High-Frequency Ingest Wake Cycles**:
+   - Every keystroke/message payload from the browser called `/api/ingest/chat`, which directly called `_wake.set()`.
+   - This forced `_run_once()` to execute immediately in a tight loop.
+3. **Continuous Re-embedding of Antigravity Transcripts**:
+   - Every active Antigravity session continuously modifies `transcript_full.jsonl` mtime.
+   - The server re-read the multi-megabyte transcript, deleted all chunks, set `emb=NULL`, and repeatedly embedded hundreds of chunks.
+4. **Missing Python Garbage Collection**:
+   - Large numpy arrays and SQLite row buffers lingered across thread cycles without explicit `gc.collect()`.
+
+## Benchmark Proof
+- Uncapped (`threads=None`, `batch_size=256`): Jumped from 205 MB to **1,869 MB** in 400 chunks, and **5,229 MB** in production.
+- Capped (`threads=2`, `batch_size=32`): Leveled off strictly at **440 MB** (flat across repeated 1,000-chunk loops).
+- Capped (`threads=1`, `batch_size=16`): Leveled off strictly at **321 MB**.
+
+## Action Items
+1. **`ctx/embed.py`**:
+   - Configure `TextEmbedding(model_name=MODEL_NAME, threads=2)`.
+   - Enforce `batch_size=32` in `embed_texts()`.
+   - Call `gc.collect()` after bulk embeddings.
+2. **`ctx/server.py`**:
+   - Add debouncing to `_wake` (minimum 30-second cooldown between background sync runs).
+   - Call `gc.collect()` in `_run_once()` finally block.
+3. **`ctx/ingest.py`**:
+   - For Antigravity transcripts, skip re-ingestion if the number of messages in the transcript hasn't changed.
+4. **Restart Daemon**:
+   - Restart `task-2173` with the hardened configuration and verify working set memory stays under 500 MB.

+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+DB_PATH = ROOT / "data" / "chats.sqlite"
+CANVASES_DIR = ROOT / "canvases"
+
+def parse_frontmatter(text: str):
+    if not text.startswith("---"):
+        return {}, text
+    parts = text.split("---", 2)
+    if len(parts) < 3:
+        return {}, text
+    meta_str, body = parts[1], parts[2].strip()
+    meta = {}
+    for line in meta_str.strip().splitlines():
+        if ":" in line:
+            k, v = line.split(":", 1)
+            k = k.strip()
+            v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
+            meta[k] = v
+    return meta, body
+
+def main():
+    con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+    
+    print("1. Repairing canvas files and database records...")
+    
+    # Clean out old un-scoped canvas rows
+    con.execute("DELETE FROM canvases WHERE id LIKE 'canvas-%' OR id LIKE 'card-%'")
+    
+    count = 0
+    for p in CANVASES_DIR.rglob("*.md"):
+        try:
+            raw_text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"Error reading {p}: {e}")
+            continue
+            
+        meta, body = parse_frontmatter(raw_text)
+        if not meta or not meta.get("chat_id"):
+            print(f"Skipping {p.name}: No chat_id in frontmatter")
+            continue
+            
+        chat_id = meta["chat_id"]
+        raw_title = meta.get("title") or p.stem
+        clean_title = re.sub(r'\s*(Contents\s*Share\s*&\s*Export\s*Create|Contents|Share\s*&\s*Export|Share|Export|Download|Close|Create)\s*$', '', raw_title, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip() or p.stem
+        c_type = meta.get("type", "markdown")
+        updated = meta.get("updated", "")
+        
+        # If title changed (e.g. stripped 'Export'), re-write file with clean frontmatter
+        if clean_title != raw_title:
+            new_doc = f"""---
+title: "{clean_title}"
+chat_id: "{chat_id}"
+chat_title: "{meta.get('chat_title', '')}"
+chat_url: "{meta.get('chat_url', '')}"
+type: "{c_type}"
+updated: "{updated}"
+---
+
+{body}
+"""
+            p.write_text(new_doc, encoding="utf-8")
+            print(f"  Cleaned frontmatter in: {p.name} ('{raw_title}' -> '{clean_title}')")
+            
+        c_id = f"{chat_id}-{hashlib.sha1(clean_title.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}"
+        
+        con.execute(
+            """INSERT INTO canvases(id, chat_id, title, content, type, file_path, updated)
+               VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
+               ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET chat_id=excluded.chat_id, title=excluded.title,
+               content=excluded.content, type=excluded.type, file_path=excluded.file_path,
+               updated=excluded.updated""",
+            (c_id, chat_id, clean_title, body, c_type, str(p), updated)
+        )
+        count += 1
+        
+    print(f"Successfully upserted {count} scoped canvases.")
+    
+    # 2. Clean message canvas tags in database
+    print("2. Cleaning message canvas tags...")
+    rows = con.execute("SELECT chat_id, idx, text FROM messages WHERE text LIKE '%[[CANVAS:%'").fetchall()
+    msg_cleaned = 0
+    for r in rows:
+        cid, idx, txt = r["chat_id"], r["idx"], r["text"]
+        new_txt = re.sub(r'\[\[CANVAS:\s*([^\]]+?)\s*(?:Contents\s*Share\s*&\s*Export\s*Create|Contents|Share\s*&\s*Export|Share|Export|Download|Close|Create)\s*\]\]', r'[[CANVAS: \1]]', txt, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
+        if new_txt != txt:
+            con.execute("UPDATE messages SET text=? WHERE chat_id=? AND idx=?", (new_txt, cid, idx))
+            msg_cleaned += 1
+            
+    print(f"Cleaned {msg_cleaned} messages with canvas tags.")
+    con.commit()
+    con.close()
+    
+    # Notify cloud sync
+    try:
+        from ctx.cloud_sync import cloud_sync
+        cloud_sync.notify_change("Canvas DB Repair")
+        print("Notified cloud sync.")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print("Cloud sync notification skipped:", e)
+        
+    print("All repairs complete!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
